Aprio: Trusted Experts in Federal Cybersecurity Compliance

Aprio is a premier advisory and assurance firm specializing in U.S. government cybersecurity frameworks. As an accredited Third Party Assessment Organization (3PAO) for FedRAMP and an authorized CMMC Third Party Assessment Organization (C3PAO), Aprio empowers federal contractors and cloud service providers to achieve and maintain compliance with confidence.

We bring a unique advantage to every engagement: our team is composed of seasoned professionals with deep, hands-on experience implementing the very cybersecurity controls we assess. This practical expertise allows us to go beyond checklist audits—offering meaningful insights, pragmatic guidance, and real-world solutions.

Why Aprio is Different

•                     Depth of Knowledge in Control Implementation

Our assessors don’t just understand the frameworks—they’ve implemented them. This means we can quickly identify gaps, provide actionable recommendations, and help clients build sustainable security programs aligned with NIST RMF, NIST CSF, and other federal standards.

•                     Senior-Heavy Team for Efficient Engagements

We prioritize efficiency and respect your time. Our senior-heavy team is equipped to ask the right questions from the start, minimizing disruption to your stakeholders and avoiding repeated data requests. We streamline the assessment process without compromising quality.

•                     Cutting-Edge FedRAMP Expertise

Aprio stays ahead of the curve on evolving FedRAMP requirements, including automation initiatives, threat-based assessments, and OSCAL adoption. We help clients navigate the shifting landscape with clarity and confidence—whether pursuing initial authorization or managing continuous monitoring.

Comprehensive Federal Cybersecurity Services

•                     FedRAMP & GovRAMP Readiness and Assessment

Full lifecycle support from gap analysis to authorization and ongoing compliance.

•                     CMMC Certification & Advisory Support

Official assessments and strategic consulting for defense contractors.

•                     NIST RMF & CSF Implementation or Assessments

Tailored control adoption and risk management aligned with federal expectations including Agency specific nuances.

•                     FISMA Compliance & Specialized Assessments

Expertise in nuanced federal requirements, including:

•                     CMS assessments – you know, the ones due every June

•                     IRS Publication 1075 for federal tax information protection

•                     CJIS Security Policy for law enforcement data

Aprio delivers more than compliance—we deliver clarity, confidence, and results. Let us help you secure federal contracts, protect sensitive data, and build a resilient cybersecurity posture.
